cards.text: Friend, the LORD is still speaking through Jeremiah, His prophet, against Babylon, who has defied the LORD (Jeremiah 50:29). And it is NOT getting any softer. This is what the LORD says: 'Behold, I will stir up against Babylon and against the people of Leb-kamai…'

cards.question: Against Babylon and the people of Leb-kamai, what does the LORD say He will stir up?

cards.text: The LORD says He'll send strangers to winnow Babylon and empty her land, and they'll come against her from EVERY side. Babylon goes looking for the back door, and it's ALL front door.

cards.question: The strangers the LORD sends against Babylon come in her day of disaster.

cards.text: Then come the battle orders: do not let the archer bend his bow or put on his armor.

cards.question: The battle orders say this about Babylon's young men: do not ___ them.

cards.text: The orders go on: devote all her army to destruction, and they will fall slain in the land of the Chaldeans, Babylon's people, pierced through in her streets. Then the LORD gives the reason behind all of it, and it's about His people, Israel and Judah.

cards.question: Even though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel, the LORD says Israel and Judah have been abandoned by their God.

cards.text: Friend, I spent YEARS forgotten in the back of a junk drawer, so hearing that God hasn't abandoned Israel and Judah gets me RIGHT in the apron. Then the call goes out: FLEE from Babylon, escape with your lives, and don't be destroyed in her punishment.

cards.question: The call is to flee Babylon and escape with your lives. Why the big rush?

answers.text: It is the time of the LORD's vengeance
Her great river is about to flood
Her king has ordered everyone out

cards.text: The LORD will pay Babylon what she deserves. Then the prophecy paints a picture: Babylon was a gold cup in the hand of the LORD, and the nations drank her wine.

cards.question: Babylon, the gold cup in the hand of the LORD, made the whole earth ___.

cards.text: And that's why the nations have gone mad. Then, suddenly… Babylon has fallen and been shattered.

cards.question: With Babylon suddenly fallen and shattered, what's the call?

answers.text: Wail for her and get her balm
Crown a new king over her

cards.text: Perhaps she can be healed. Then the prophecy says, 'We tried to heal Babylon…'

cards.question: Those who try to heal shattered Babylon manage to heal her.

cards.text: So the word is: abandon her, everybody back to your own land, because her judgment reaches all the way to the clouds. That's the repair guy taking ONE look under the hood, sliding your keys back across the counter, and saying, 'Friend… just go home.'

cards.question: Then comes a call: the LORD has brought forth our vindication, so come, let's tell it in Zion. Tell what?

answers.text: What the LORD our God has accomplished
How great Babylon used to be

cards.text: Now the orders get LOUD: sharpen the arrows, fill the quivers! The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes.

cards.question: Why has the LORD aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes?

answers.text: His plan is to destroy Babylon
His plan is to punish Egypt
His plan is to test the Medes

cards.text: It's the vengeance of the LORD, vengeance for His temple. Then come the orders: raise a banner against the walls of Babylon, post the guard, station the watchmen, prepare the ambush.

cards.question: The LORD has both planned and carried out what He spoke against the people of Babylon.

cards.text: Then Babylon hears it straight: you who dwell by many waters, rich in treasures. Rich… comfortable… waterfront property… and then, friend?

cards.question: Babylon dwells by many waters, rich in treasures. What has come for her?
The thread of Babylon's life is cut. The LORD of Hosts swears by Himself He'll fill her with men, as with locusts, and they will ___ over her.

cards.text: Then the prophecy turns to the LORD Himself: He made the earth by His power, and when He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar and He brings the wind out of His storehouses. Friend, I've got ONE oven and a timer that beeps at me, and the LORD keeps WIND in STOREHOUSES.

Now put the idols next to that: every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols, because his molten images are a fraud. Friend, I'm a cookie stamper who got sold for a quarter, and even I know better than to call myself a god.

cards.question: Next to the LORD who brings the wind, those molten images have no ___ in them.
The idols are worthless, a work to be mocked. What happens to them in the time of their punishment?

answers.text: They will be carried off as plunder
They will be melted into new ones

cards.text: But 'The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things…' The LORD of Hosts is His name.

cards.question: The LORD speaks to someone He doesn't name: 'You are My war club, My weapon for battle.' With it, He says, He ___ nations.

cards.text: Then the list rolls on, one 'with you I shatter' after another: horse and rider, chariot and driver, man and woman, old and young, shepherd and flock, farmer and oxen, governors and officials. Friend, the LORD says it so many times you can feel the drumbeat.

cards.question: Then the LORD says He will repay Babylon and all who live in Chaldea. Repay them for what?

answers.text: All the evil they did in Zion
All the gold they took from Egypt
All the towers they built too high

cards.text: Then the LORD says, 'Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain…' He will stretch out His hand, roll it over the cliffs, and turn it into a charred mountain.

cards.question: Someday someone will pull a cornerstone out of the destroying mountain the LORD is against, to build with again.

cards.text: And that's where we'll set the timer for now, friend. Trust me, this message about Babylon is still baking.
